findings.old_state: Hiring manager emails HR a PDF offer summary, and HR manually creates a paper onboarding folder.
findings.new_state: Onboarding is initiated automatically the moment a hiring manager marks an offer as 'Accepted' in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

findings.old_state: HR manually enters the employee into the HRIS system by hand, typically 1-2 business days after the email.
findings.new_state: Marking the offer as Accepted automatically creates an employee record in the HRIS via API integration with no manual re-entry.

findings.old_state: HR prints and mails a paper welcome packet, tax forms (W-4, I-9), and benefits enrollment forms to the employee's home address. The employee completes paper forms and returns them by mail or in person on day one.
findings.new_state: A system-generated digital welcome packet, e-signature tax forms (W-4, I-9), and benefits enrollment are sent to the employee's personal email and are due before day one.

findings.old_state: IT is notified via a separate email from HR after HRIS entry, and an IT technician manually provisions access by following a printed checklist over 3-5 business days.
findings.new_state: An automated ticket is created in the IT provisioning system with role-based access templates, and a laptop is shipped.

findings.old_state: HR manually files paper forms in a physical cabinet and re-keys selected fields into the HRIS and payroll systems.
findings.new_state: Paper forms and physical filing are eliminated.

findings.old_state: The hiring manager manually schedules first-week meetings and shadowing sessions by emailing relevant team members individually.
findings.new_state: First-week meetings and shadowing sessions are auto-scheduled based on a role-based onboarding template and synced to calendars, with options for the hiring manager to customize.

findings.old_state: Compliance training is assigned verbally by the manager with no automated tracking of completion.
findings.new_state: There is a full audit trail of compliance training completion.

findings.old_state: Finance receives new-hire payroll setup information manually from HR, often by walking a paper form to the Finance office.
findings.new_state: HR, IT, Finance, and the hiring manager all see the same real-time onboarding status dashboard.

findings.old_state: Employees completed a paper Expense Claim Form (Form EX-12) by hand, stapled original receipts to the back, and sent it to Accounts Payable by interoffice mail.
findings.new_state: Expense claims are submitted, checked, approved, and paid inside the SpendFlow mobile and web app where employees photograph each receipt.

findings.old_state: An Accounts Payable clerk checked the arithmetic on the form and keyed each line into the general ledger by hand.
findings.new_state: Accounts Payable no longer keys claims by hand and acts only on exceptions, while optical character recognition reads the amount, date, and vendor from photographed receipts.

findings.old_state: Finance conducted a quarterly 5% sample for review.
findings.new_state: Finance samples 2% of auto-approved claims each month for manual review.

1. The employee photographs each receipt in the SpendFlow app. Optical character recognition reads the amount, date and vendor and fills in the claim line.

findings.old_state: Anyone who notices an outage calls the service desk. Monitoring tools raise alarms on a wall display, but they do not create tickets.
findings.new_state: A monitoring alert creates an incident in PagerRelay with a proposed severity. There is no need to phone the service desk.

findings.old_state: The service desk agent logs a ticket by hand and classifies it as major or minor based on personal judgement, because there are no written severity definitions.
findings.new_state: Each level has a written definition so that two people classify the same issue the same way.

findings.old_state: For a major incident, the agent follows the printed phone tree and calls the on-call engineer's mobile phone. If there is no answer after 10 minutes, the agent calls the next engineer on the list.
findings.new_state: The on-call engineer is paged through the mobile app, then by SMS, then by phone call, until someone respond
